source: YouTube auto-caption transcript 0:00-16:45 (tools/video_draft.py transcript 9DbAUGoSM5Y --start 0 --end 1005); nothing past 16:45 read. 'type' marks each idea as claim, heuristic or one-off pick; 'repeats' lists ideas of earlier videos it restates; 'related' lists looser topic matches. Solo draft: every idea is the host's (speaker field kept for the schema).

ideas.speaker: NicolaiBolas (host)
ideas.claim: Return to the Light Realms is a mythic that is not particularly good, but the neat card he likes to try out to see whether building around it is worth playing.
ideas.quote: It's not particularly good, but it's the exact sort of kind of fun neat card that I like trying out.
ideas.test_idea: GIH WR of Return to the Light Realms.

ideas.speaker: NicolaiBolas (host)
ideas.claim: To win the Pro Tour from this pack: Fblthp, Knows the Way, then Break Under Pressure, then Fblthp, Impossibly Lost; premium removal is harder to find than card draw.
ideas.quote: I think that card draw is a little easier to find than premium removal sometimes.
ideas.test_idea: GIH WR of Fblthp, Knows the Way against Break Under Pressure.

ideas.speaker: NicolaiBolas (host)
ideas.claim: He has a rule not to pass Mindseeker Oculus, and every time he passes one he regrets it; he takes it over Your Fate Ends Here, even though it is awkward with a white Return to the Light Realms.
ideas.quote: Every time I pass a Mind Seeker Oculus, I regret it.
ideas.test_idea: GIH WR of Mindseeker Oculus against Your Fate Ends Here.

ideas.speaker: NicolaiBolas (host)
ideas.claim: Do not bias picks towards a colour early because of one strong late-game card: he refuses to go white just because he has Return to the Light Realms.
ideas.quote: I don't like to bias my picks that much early.
ideas.test_idea: Share of drafters ending in the colour of their first rare.

ideas.speaker: NicolaiBolas (host)
ideas.claim: Multiply by Zero is a really good kill spell that kills a lot of things, but has to be careful of prowess and +1/+1 counters; an Esper control deck with Return to the Light Realms would be good.
ideas.quote: You just have to be careful they don't have prowess or plus and plus and counters, that sort of thing.
ideas.test_idea: GIH WR of Multiply by Zero; win rate by opposing creature type.

ideas.speaker: NicolaiBolas (host)
ideas.claim: No Admittance is miles ahead of the next best card in its pack, and a fourth colour in four picks does not worry him.
ideas.quote: No Admittance is like miles ahead of the next best card.
ideas.test_idea: GIH WR of No Admittance against its P1p4 alternatives.

ideas.speaker: NicolaiBolas (host)
ideas.claim: Undulating Witness over Proft, Sinister Mastermind: in a Return to the Light Realms deck he wants landcyclers (especially the creature ones) rather than more removal.
ideas.quote: I feel like I'm going to want some land cyclers in my return to the light realms deck.
ideas.test_idea: GIH WR of Undulating Witness in decks with Return to the Light Realms.

ideas.speaker: NicolaiBolas (host)
ideas.claim: He would rather his top end be land-cycling creatures than the Archive Arbiter: they fix and can be brought back with Return to the Light Realms.
ideas.quote: I'd rather my top end be land cyclers is what I meant. Like the land cycling creatures really help.
ideas.test_idea: GIH WR of Archive Arbiter against landcycler creatures.

ideas.speaker: NicolaiBolas (host)
ideas.claim: Fblthp, Knows the Way wheels at pick 9 in a five-colour-ish pack: nobody else wants it, which he reads as proof a multicolour fixing legend is undervalued.
ideas.quote: Five-color Fblthp knows the way. Nobody wants it. It's all mine.
ideas.test_idea: ALSA and wheel rate of Fblthp, Knows the Way.

ideas.speaker: NicolaiBolas (host)
ideas.claim: The deck that wants Murmuring Volume more than any card is a five-colour late-game deck: he passes lands for it.
ideas.quote: I don't like passing lands, but I will pass them for murmuring volumes. This is like priority numero uno for me.
ideas.test_idea: GIH WR of Murmuring Volume by number of colours in the deck.

ideas.speaker: NicolaiBolas (host)
ideas.claim: Craftwork Crusher is another top-end card: with double white, double green and double red already, he will splash lightly for removal and base in green.
ideas.quote: Crusher, let's go. Another top end card.
ideas.test_idea: GIH WR of Craftwork Crusher in decks with fewer than three colours.

ideas.speaker: NicolaiBolas (host)
ideas.claim: Vinelasher Adept is a better landcycler than Hexhaven Battalion for a Return to the Light Realms deck because Return can bring it back; he takes Extended Absence anyway to keep a dip into black for removal.
ideas.quote: I'm just going to take Extended Absence, keep my dip into black for some removal intact.
ideas.test_idea: GIH WR of Extended Absence against Hexhaven Battalion.

ideas.speaker: NicolaiBolas (host)
ideas.claim: He wants his five-drops to be landcyclers when he can: Awaken the Inferno over Wrecking Gecko.
ideas.quote: I just want my five drops to be land cyclers when I can.
ideas.test_idea: GIH WR of Awaken the Inferno against Wrecking Gecko.

ideas.speaker: NicolaiBolas (host)
ideas.claim: Any white land helps a Return to the Light Realms deck: lands are good pickups for him, so Fatehold Annex over Grim Repriser (which lacks ways to ping).
ideas.quote: Lands are good pickups for me.
ideas.test_idea: Play rate of dual lands in five-colour decks.

ideas.speaker: NicolaiBolas (host)
ideas.claim: Semester Foreseer is a bigger body to bring back than Fatehold Chronologist, so he takes it for the Return plan.
ideas.quote: I'd rather have Semester Foreseer cuz it's just like a bigger body to bring back.
ideas.test_idea: GIH WR of Semester Foreseer.

ideas.speaker: NicolaiBolas (host)
ideas.claim: Karn, Gilded Guardian wheels: 'Mabel would almost certainly be a better pickup, but we have to try this' in the Warrior's Blades five-colour deck.
ideas.quote: Mabel would almost certainly be a better pick up, but we have to try this if we're playing the Warriors Blades deck.
ideas.test_idea: GIH WR of Karn, Gilded Guardian in 4-5 colour decks.

ideas.speaker: NicolaiBolas (host)
ideas.claim: Violent Echoes is a card he will take even though it is double red: kill something, draw a card, and he needs card draw to reach nine mana.
ideas.quote: I like this kill spell a lot. Kill something, draw a card. I need card draw to make sure I can get to nine mana.
ideas.test_idea: GIH WR of Violent Echoes by number of red sources.

ideas.speaker: NicolaiBolas (host)
ideas.claim: Something Worth Saving is counterintuitive in a Return to the Light Realms deck because milling the mythic away loses it.
ideas.quote: Something worth saving doesn't like if I mill my Return to Light realms I can't get it. Um which does worry me.
ideas.test_idea: Win rate of Something Worth Saving by presence of Return to the Light Realms.

ideas.speaker: NicolaiBolas (host)
ideas.claim: Recursive Recruitment is a late-game graveyard payoff bomb and a backup Return to the Light Realms, and also an artifact for Karn.
ideas.quote: Recruitment's just exactly what I want. Late game graveyard payoff bomb.
ideas.test_idea: GIH WR of Recursive Recruitment.

ideas.speaker: NicolaiBolas (host)
ideas.claim: A land over a good playable late in pack 3 when playables are plentiful: Theorix Annex and Konstrari Annex over Vinelasher Adept and others, because the deck wants lots of lands.
ideas.quote: I haven't started taking lands here. I have plenty of playables.
ideas.test_idea: Play rate of lands taken in pack 3.

ideas.speaker: NicolaiBolas (host)
ideas.claim: Hapatra, the Desert Frost is better than Stingerquill Charm for a slow deck: it buys time, and Stingerquill Charm needs two particular colours.
ideas.quote: It buys me time, though. And I was slow deck, so probably better than Stingerquill Charm, which requires two unique colors.
ideas.test_idea: GIH WR of Hapatra, the Desert Frost against Stingerquill Charm.

ideas.speaker: NicolaiBolas (host)
ideas.claim: He builds a five-colour 'pile': four or five colours on a few green cards, Murmuring Volumes and Fblthp for fixing, and he cuts the cheap cards (Gallia, Campus Crier, Afterthought Sentries, Semester Foreseer) and Traxos.
ideas.quote: This is what you get when you're like, 'Well, I'll try Return to Light Realms.'
ideas.test_idea: Win rate of 4-5 colour decks by fixing count.

ideas.speaker: NicolaiBolas (host)
ideas.claim: Count sources by colour in the five-colour mana: six green, three or four red; double-pip cards are single in white and blue, none in black; 'a pile of cards'.
ideas.quote: Four, five, six green sources. Three, four red sources.
ideas.test_idea: Win rate by source counts in 5-colour decks.
